== Name

inline-image-test - test image fallbacks

== Synopsis

*inline-image-test*

== Description

An inline image: image:logo.png[Company Logo].

An inline image without alt text: image:icon.png[].

A linked inline image: image:status-badge.svg[Build status,link=https://example.com/status].

A linked inline image without alt text: image:release-badge.svg[link=https://example.com/release].

.A block image
image::sunset.jpg[Sunset photo]

image::untitled.png[]

.A linked block image
image::architecture-diagram.svg[System architecture,link=https://example.com/architecture]
